data.one_liner: Flutter E2E test driver for LLM agents and CLI via VM Service extensions without a test harness.
data.what_it_does: Provides 41 CLI commands and 39 MCP tools to drive a running Flutter application over VM Service extensions. It snapshots semantics trees, captures screenshots, and performs gestures without needing a traditional flutter_test harness.
use_when: You want AI agents to interact with and test your running Flutter application.
You need unscripted end-to-end automation via CLI commands or Model Context Protocol tools.
avoid_when: You are writing traditional unit or widget tests using the flutter_test harness.
You are running production builds (dusk is debug-only and tree-shaked in release).
strengths: Hot-restart safe and does not require separate test files.
Bridges human CLI workflows and AI agent MCP tool calls using the same contracts.
Features a 6-step actionability gate and stable ref system for reliable element targeting.
weaknesses: Debug-only tool that must be explicitly guarded against release builds.
Requires proper lifecycle and platform setup (like VM Service extension wiring).
data.setup_notes: Run flutter pub add fluttersdk_dusk followed by dart run fluttersdk_dusk dusk:install, then wrap DuskPlugin.install() in !kReleaseMode in lib/main.dart.

alternatives.name: test
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose the standard test package when you want to write traditional unit, widget, or integration tests with standard test runners.

data.minimal_example:
flutter pub add fluttersdk_dusk
dart run fluttersdk_dusk dusk:install
